meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: Claude 会在分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等关键节点写入事件，按 trace_id 串成可追溯证据链并生成向量索引，提供按 trace_id、时间窗、官署维度的检索，支撑审计面板与回滚定位。
howto.when: 当你构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测与安全审计时触发；也可由各官署在关键操作节点调用，或经事件总线异步推送事件时接管。

say.text: 按 trace_id 检索这次分发的完整证据链
say.note: 返回该链路串联的全部事件

say.text: 对最近一小时的所有操作做一次审计检索
say.note: 按时间窗返回历史证据

say.text: 把这次扫描事件写入证据链并生成向量索引
say.note: 写入事件并新增索引条目

howto.what_en: Claude writes events at key nodes such as dispatch, scan, parse and card generation, links them into a trace_id evidence chain, builds a vector index, and answers queries by trace_id, time window or office for audits and rollbacks.
howto.when_en: Use it when you build multi-agent systems needing end-to-end observability and security audit, or when offices report events at key operation nodes via the event bus.

say_en.text: Retrieve the full evidence chain for this dispatch by trace_id
say_en.note: Returns all events linked to that trace

say_en.text: Audit all operations from the last hour
say_en.note: Returns historical evidence by time window

say_en.text: Write this scan event into the evidence chain and index it
say_en.note: Stores the event and adds a vector entry
